_comment: Driver catalog for nvidia-driver-support. The picker in install-nvidia-driver.sh reads this. `open_latest` is the newest open-capable driver per distinct major/train (newest first), capped at open_latest_count and never above NVIDIA's blessed production latest (latest.txt) — so betas / new-feature-branch releases NVIDIA published but hasn't promoted are excluded, and every listed version ships a real -no-compat32.run. Users can still install ANY version (incl. betas / above-latest) via --driver=X.Y.Z. `branches` pins one version per legacy series; `chip_map` maps an NVIDIA chip prefix to a recommended branch. This file is regenerated daily by .github/workflows/check-drivers.yml — hand-edits to open_latest/branches[].version will be overwritten. Seed values below are all real, shipping driver versions.

latest.note: Newest open-module driver in open_latest (Turing and newer).

legacy-580.note: Last branch for Maxwell/Pascal/Volta. Security-only through Oct 2028. Open modules need Turing+, so proprietary.

legacy-470.note: Last branch for Kepler. Builds against modern 6.x kernels.
